pages.title: Why build one
pages.text: Solar panels on a station make twice as much power. It helps find objects on the planet below and works well as a staging base.

pages.title: How to build it
pages.text: Open the map during a rocket flight, choose the planet and press the station button. The map lists the materials: carry them in the rocket or your inventory.

pages.title: Life on board
pages.text: There is no air on a station, so build a $(l:space/survival/oxygen#sealer)sealed room$() first. Without Spin Thrusters there is no gravity. GalaxySpace also lets you build stations around $(l:space/planets/mars)Mars$() and $(l:space/planets/venus)Venus$().

pages.title: Advanced Solar Panel
pages.text: Makes twice the power on a station.
